authorization: Latest user instruction reopens only 250 calibration and 150 validation facts for causal feature extraction, candidate-layer hard branches and actual automatic validation. Stage B remains prohibited until acceptance and user confirmation.
familiarity_target: known(param+align) versus unknown(ext+abstain), balanced binary fit
projection_rule: full-dimensional standardized features, no PCA; paired contrast removes intercept in training, not an online paired context
thresholds: AND of familiarity and conflict; calibration OOF empirical threshold quantiles [0,.25,.5,.75,.9,.95,.975,1] plus no-block
threshold_constraint: calibration OOF ext false blocks <=1 percent; maximize param intercept recall, then fewer trusted blocks, then fewer total blocks
candidate_screen: Within each layer and training mode, choose feature/factor fits and AND thresholds on calibration OOF only; validation outputs never used for feature/C/threshold selection
validation_layer_selection: report all four predeclared layer finalists per training mode; choose a provisional unique best passing known-pair candidate by validation Macro, H, lower layer. User confirmation is still required before stage-B lock

acceptance.statistical_rule: all three positive improvements vs cached Vanilla; paired fact swap p with Holm across 4 layers x3 endpoints within each model, known-pair main candidates only; all-pair controls descriptive
acceptance.automatic_validation: generate all 300 validation inputs for provisional selected known-pair candidate; require exact cached-composition answers/routes and ordinary decoder call audit before declaring accepted

feature_precision: float16 causal tensors and norm+LM-head, fp16 frozen linear deployment scores; offline estimators and covariance algebra float64
lens: frozen final norm+lm_head applied to current early-layer last/focal vectors only; extra head projections counted and timed separately; <0.1ms is a hypothesis, not an assumed result
forbidden_inputs: final-layer Vanilla probabilities as gate inputs
monitoring: first five minutes only, then stop following until user completion notice
